title: Retractable hooks and garment rod 10-Inch Wall Mount Solid Brass Allied Brass
short_title: Retractable hooks and garment rod 10-Inch Wall Mount
description:
Add space-saving hanging storage with this retractable hooks and garment rod, designed to extend when you need it and retract when not in use. Crafted from solid brass with concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean, traditional look in bathrooms, laundry areas, and dressing spaces.

Highlights:
- Pullout rod extends to create a convenient place to hang garments or towels
- Retracts to help keep your wall area clear when not in use
- Wall-mount installation in an end wall or door frame
- Solid brass construction for enduring everyday use
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a refined finish

Specs:
- Style: Traditional
- Material: Brass
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Size: 10-Inch projection; overall dimensions 10-Inch L x 2-Inch W x 1.9-Inch H
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Depth required to retract: 10 inches of wall depth
- Included: Brass rod, rod housing, and all installation hardware
- Assembly: No assembly required
- Finish options: Available in 28 designer finishes, including statement colors
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

_previous.title: Traditional Retractable Pullout Garment Rod
_previous.description: Enjoy the convenience of this pull out garment rod in many places around your home. Rod installs in an end wall or door frame and retracts when not in use. When the rod is extended it provides a handy place to hang your garments or towels. Great in a laundry area, dressing area or in the bathroom. Garment rod requires 10 inches of wall depth to retract. Crafted of the finest solid brass materials and provided with one of our designer lifetime finishes.
